plugins.name: sakal-automation
plugins.description: Agent automation for sakal-dev / Thalias repos: install (onboard a repo in <30 min), operate (queue/unblock/upgrade/diagnose), dispatch (hand briefs to cloud executors). Implements the SOURCE → BRIEF → EXECUTE → GATE contract in docs/task-contract.md.

plugins.name: sakalmaster
plugins.description: Build a committed .sakal/ spec-tracker directory from a repo: /sakal-onboard turns its specs, docs and issues into journeys, epics, stories and ACs — fully local, nothing leaves the machine, re-runs converge. Install this WITHOUT the agent-automation stack; the two plugins are independent.
